sections.title: Before booking in Spokane
sections.html:
Ask to see an anonymous example of the deliverable before deciding. A seasonal palette organizes you within a framework; a custom fabric palette may select individual shades outside a standard collection. Find out who evaluates your appearance, whether you meet in person, and how revisions work. More swatches or a higher fee alone do not tell you whether the result will help with your actual wardrobe.

  • Is this a ready-made seasonal palette or an individually assembled one?
  • Will I meet the analyst, and are physical fabric samples included?

sections.title: Make the result useful in your everyday wardrobe
sections.html: If you mostly need guidance while shopping, start by listing three garments you want to coordinate. A phone palette and color comparison tool may be enough to explore that small task. If physical samples and a detailed human discussion are what you value, budget for that service explicitly. Keep the app suggestion and any consultant result labeled by their own system rather than forcing every name to match.
